verdict.rationale: Interview preparation is a fair question for an ATS like Lever, but the evidence pack never shows calendar invites carrying an interview kit or scorecard, and never mentions automated reminders to submit feedback. The AI interview-question generator and AI interview transcripts are adjacent features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
